component.name: ElyShow
component.summary: Presentation editor for PPTX and ODP files

description.p: This is a community package of ElyShow, maintained independently. It repackages the official upstream Linux build unmodified.
ElyShow is the presentation app of Ely Office, a set of offline-first desktop apps written in Rust with GPUI. It opens and saves PPTX, ODP and PPT files, with LibreOfficeKit as the document engine.

ul.li: Slide editing and a full-screen slide show
Saves back to the original format; Save As writes a new file and leaves the original alone
Recovery points every 10 seconds while there are unsaved changes, kept only on this computer
Optional auto-save, zoom, printing and export

description.p: ElyShow works fully offline. The package shares the network only because opening a second file hands it to the window already open over a local connection. It can read and write your Documents and Downloads folders; other files are opened and saved through the file chooser, or from your file manager. Settings and recovery points live in ~/.var/app/ely.zacharyzhang.office.show.
To open files anywhere in your home directory by path: flatpak override --user --filesystem=home ely.zacharyzhang.office.show. Undo with flatpak override --user --reset ely.zacharyzhang.office.show.
In-app updates are left to Flatpak: new upstream releases arrive as Flatpak updates.
